it’s taiwan.

talks suspended, ceasefire now indefinite. 

trump edging closer to getting out of the war irrespective of outcomes in the region.

puppet regime wins our first webby!

best current affairs (they call it comedy) on social media.

heartfelt thanks (felt, see what i did there) from me and @gzeromedia for all your support!!

a xi-trump meeting is coming.
expect yuge pageantry.
watch the ask on taiwan.
@gzeromedia

Video
more delays on vp vance traveling to islamabad. but negotiations on core issues still proceeding, just pushes trump on extending out (or not breaching) ceasefire.
the risk is not that machines become conscious. it’s that we stop being so.
turns out it doesn’t take much to hold a $110 trillion global economy at risk.

trump can announce a deal with iran anytime.
getting it to stick is a different story.
@gzeromedia

Video

iran ceasefire holding. for now.
talks coming. deal announcement looking reasonably likely.
implementation? that's a different matter.
@gzeromedia

Video

it’s proven much easier to program human beings to act like computers than to program computers to act like humans beings. 

if we don’t make it as a species, i fear this will be the reason.
a weekend moose is a happy moose

during the first round of talks, iran said lebanon ceasefire was precondition…and then quietly dropped that red line. 

i wouldn’t read that much into iranian demands on the united states lifting blockade or else no talks...
fifth time president trump has threatened to destroy iranian civilian infrastructure with a deadline attached.
an extraordinary set of responses

the iranian government—the hardliners included—have every reason to engage in talks with the united states that extends the ceasefire. 

implementing an agreement is another matter.

even finland president alex stubb—one of the strongest pro-american leaders in europe today—expressing his unhappiness with what he considers trump’s america alone policies of late.

Video

viktor orbán has been decisively voted out of power, losing to péter maygar.
this wasn’t a shift to the left, it was a rejection of kleptocracy. linkedin.com/posts/ianbremme…

imf and world bank resume relations with venezuela.

the economy will substantially improve. the politics a different question.

the outlines of a us-iran deal are taking shape/getting closer. 

the us wants iran's enriched uranium stockpile and a 20-year moratorium on enrichment. iran is offering stockpile plus 5 years, wants $20 billion in frozen funds released plus sanctions relief.
